resources.string: Hold Volume Down with the screen off to take photos or record video.
Use the default system action for the volume button.
Take up to 100 photos per burst.
Record video with sound, with a short vibration when recording starts and stops.

If HEIC cannot be used with these settings, photos are saved as JPG instead. The saved format is shown under Last capture.
Higher resolutions may slow down burst shooting.

No vibration for photos. Video recording still vibrates at the start and end.
Once hidden, CameraSnap can still be opened from the camera settings. Turn this off to show the icon again.
With the screen off, hold Volume Down to start capturing and release it to stop. Turning on the screen or pressing Power or Volume Up also stops capture. Maximum duration: 1 hour.
Enable CameraSnap in LSPosed, add the camera app and System Framework to its scope, then restart your phone. Camera access is required; video recording also needs microphone access.
